_comment: REFINE one picked result (ported from the IBRA generator): the image is encoded to a latent (20 LoadImage → 21 VAEEncode) and re-sampled at partial denoise, so the composition survives and only detail is re-rendered. Runs on Z-Image Turbo — the family this install has (setup:zimage) — at CFG 1 with the negative zeroed, exactly like the txt2img graph. Node ids follow the house zimage convention (28 UNET, 30 CLIP, 29 VAE, 6 prompt, 3 sampler, 8 decode, 9 save) so resolveWorkflow and compilePrompt patch it unchanged.
_denoise: denoise < 1 is the whole point: 1.0 ignores the source, 0 returns it untouched. ~0.5 keeps the picked composition and adds detail. The plugin clamps it into a sane band.
